facts.fact: Gabonreview reports that on 28 April 2026 the DGI, CNSS and CNAMGS launched work on the Declaration unique des salaires, in which the NIF for employers and the NIP for employees becomes compulsory, with operation targeted for July 2026.

note: The document says the NIP is compulsory but does not say it is checked against a national ID database.

systems.system: plateforme de consultation de la liste électorale (www.consultation.listelectorale.ga)

note: The page has citizens enter their NIP and name to look up their electoral-roll entry and polling centre; it does not state that the NIP is checked against the national ID register, so it is a lookup keyed on the number, not a recorded check.
General digitalisation framework ordinance (interoperability principle, art. 9); it names no digital ID, identity verification or system relying on one.
The passages held give only the electoral code's definitions (including biometrics) and no identity check against a national ID by another system.
No check against the national ID is stated.

facts.fact: The amended Digital Gabon financing agreement (effective 2 September 2026) finances digital authentication of social protection beneficiaries' identity and upgrading ID authentication technology for the civil service HR system, both against the RBPP ID system.

note: Database line only; it states no system checking the ID.
